discoveries.text: R1 (decisions/2026-10-26-real-test-counts) and R2 (decisions/2026-10-26-reviews-sized-to-milestone) are both on main, so M5 and M6 keep their bases; nothing is dropped. The lanes run (P1/P2) is NOT on main: the driver is serial, so the array order is the build order (M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6) and `after` only keeps a stuck milestone from blocking the independent ones.

The suite is split: a new check goes in a tests/checks/NN-<slug>.sh file by topic (sourcing tests/lib.sh, suite_setup … suite_end) and its name must be added to tests/fixtures/check-names.txt in C sort order (`LC_ALL=C sort -u`), or the full run's conformance check fails. Run a subset by file-name fragment: `bash tests/run.sh backlog`. Full suite ~206 s with TEST_JOBS=4, 395 checks at init.

restrict() in lib/driver.sh (line 87) with `nothing` (the retro) reverts EVERY file the retro changed or created, the run directory included: an added file is `git rm`'d. So retro-proposals.json must be copied from $RUN_DIR to $SCRATCH in retro() (lib/driver.sh:499-511) before `restrict "$rstart" nothing retro`, and finish() merges from the scratch copy. ledger() (line 513) holds `flock 9` on $STATE_ROOT/ledger.lock and commits only when LEDGER_COMMIT=1 and $LEDGER is a git checkout; the suite sets HARNESS_LEDGER=$T/ledger (not a git repo) and LEDGER_COMMIT=0.

Prompt variables: lib/render.mjs fills {{NAME}} from env HARNESS_NAME, empty when unset. prompt_render in lib/prompt.sh:62-78 adds prompts/parts/rules.md only when the worktree has a CLAUDE.md, and for the retro adds only that part; the M2 block must be appended for the no-CLAUDE.md case too. The retro's env is set at lib/driver.sh:502 (HARNESS_LEDGER etc.) before `prompt retro`. Rendered prompts of a stub run are at $HARNESS_STATE/proj/<run>/prompt-<kind>.md and beside each transcript as logs/NN-<id>.prompt.md.

tests/stub-claude.sh acts out sessions keyed on the prompt's first line; the retro branch is `"# Retro")` near line 154 (STUB_RETRO_EDITS writes retro-hack.txt and appends to progress.md), the coding branch near line 68 reads the feature id from the `Feature:` line under `# This session`; entry() writes entry.json by jq; new STUB_* flags are documented in the stub's header comment. The stub initializer writes a fixed 3-feature list (A, B in M1; C in M2): a review-gate check (M6) needs a flag for a list with a 3-build milestone plus a review feature.

The debrief gatherer block to change for M1 is exactly lib/debrief.sh lines 164-165 (`echo; echo "## Earlier retros …"` and `ls -t "$LEDGER"/*/*/retro.md | head -20 | fence`), inside the `{ … } > "$CTX"` group; the parked n8n-events run (A2) moves that block later, so keep the change inside it. `harness debrief --dry-run` prints the context without a session (cheap in a check). The debrief session's ALLOW list (lib/debrief.sh ~line 200) would need `harness backlog list` added if the session is to run it; the gathered context makes that unnecessary.

Context pack: lib/entries.mjs pack() (lines 193-275) has five parts in fixed priority; `entries.mjs pack <run dir> <feature> <cap>` is called by context() in lib/driver.sh:284-300 with $CONTEXT_PACK_BYTES (lib/config.sh:28, default 8192); verify() calls `context "$m"` per round. The worktree is three directories above the run dir (.harness/runs/<run>). validate() (lines 36-76) and normalize() (85-96) list the accepted entry fields: a new field (`resolved`) must be added to both or it is dropped. Existing pack checks: `context.md carries the earlier attempt's dead end` in tests/checks/13, 14, 15 (cap 8192 asserted with `wc -c`) and tests/checks/12-journal-pure-e4-entrys.sh.

On 2026-10-26 every project with a CLAUDE.md (dj-crate-streaming 105 lines, hit_list 181, n8n-home 120, pathways 49, portfolio_site 127, rane-one-mixxx 92, voice-concierge 56) already has `## Where things go` and `## Gotchas` (chunk 3 Part 2); none sets DECISIONS= in .harness/config.sh; agent-harness itself has neither heading (51 lines, and its `How to verify` line stores `395 checks`, which memlint will flag). backups, career, ideas, library, proposals and setup have no CLAUDE.md and no .harness/project.md. Record this in M2's decision file.

M4 fixture sources, verified read-only in the projects' histories (reading other projects is allowed; never write there): dj-crate-streaming `git show ed75a2d^:CLAUDE.md` line 16 (`~1,870 tests, **about 11-12 minutes**`); pathways `git show 4cafb65^:.harness/project.md` lines 18-24 (`no rename tonight`, `if time looks short`; the file was removed at 4cafb65); rane-one-mixxx `git show aa88421^:docs/decisions.md` lines 3-5 (the current-rule-set header, added in 266f369) and line 110 (`**Superseded in part by D17** (2026-10-21)` with no `Updated in place`); the tidy version is `aa88421:docs/decisions.md`. Run `git -C <project dir> show <commit>:<path>` from the worktree; trim to the cited lines plus a little context; first line of each fixture names repo, commit, path.

Test counts: lib/testcount.mjs testCount() is first-rule-wins (node, cargo, jest, go, generic); lib/check.sh writes `<n> tests` into the green marker $STATE/green/green-<key> and appends it to its green line with sed; run_init (lib/driver.sh:302-318) writes tests-start once and notes `test count: no match …` once per run via $STATE/testcount-nomatch; finish() (lines 531-535) writes tests-end from the marker or check-<key>.out. The driver loop's post-session `green` check is at line ~745 (`if F passes … && ! green`). A real agent-harness check.out for a fixture is this run's scratch /tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-10-25-memory/check.out (ends `395/395 checks passed`); copy and trim it before finish deletes scratch.

Review gate (M6): `F next` (features.mjs `next`) returns `id\tmodel\tmilestone` with the feature's own model via modelId(); the driver reads it at `IFS=$'\t' read -r id mdl milestone <<< "$next"` (~line 700) and passes $mdl to `session coding`; `F kind "$LIST" "$id"` gives the kind. The verify escalation pattern to mirror is verify() lines 398-470 (models array VERIFY_MODEL then VERIFY_ESCALATE_MODEL, note `re-running on …`). metrics.jsonl rows carry model and kind (MET append at ~line 752). evals/NEXT.md's existing sections 1-4 show the command format (`EVAL_BUDGET_USD=35 harness eval run --set default --harness <tag> --label <l>`, `harness eval compare A B`).

Decision files: journal/decisions/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md, title line, provenance line in italics (run, feature, spec section, plan), then `- **Finding:**`, `- **Choice:**`, `- **Rejected:**` bullets (see journal/decisions/2026-10-26-real-test-counts.md). Never number one, never append to journal/decisions.md. Plans: docs/plans/<date>-<milestone>-<topic>.md, header as docs/plans/2026-10-26-F2-initializer-verify.md (`Checked against main at <sha>`, `What main already has`, one feature per item).

Lint rules (features.mjs lint) flag a path in `~` or $HOME in a step (outside-repo) and a grep whose pattern matches the step's own text when the target is progress.md, entries.jsonl, context.md or feature_list.json (self-match); harness-log.md is not a quoting file. Steps here name checks by their check name instead; a session's `proposed_changes` is where a wrong step goes.

questions: M6 escalation signal: the driver reads `<n> Critical` / `<n> Important` from the review session's entry summary (else its final message). Default taken; say if you want the review to write a structured findings file instead.

M3 pack: `Current rules` is the last pack part at most a quarter of the cap, and a `project` discovery leaves `Promote to Gotchas` once a `## Gotchas` line shares its first 40 characters. Both defaults taken; say if you want another share or match rule.
M5: the structured `TEST_REPORT` option of retro-followups §C is not built (the `HARNESS_TESTS=<n>` contract line covers it: a project's check prints it from its own report). Default taken.
M4: memlint runs at every segment start (a continue re-lints: the project may have changed), not once per run. Default taken.
header:
# Progress — run `agent-harness-2026-10-25-memory` (agent-harness)

What this file is: the harness renders it from `entries.jsonl` after every session, newest entry first (15 in full, then one line each; `progress-archive.md` has every entry). Don't edit it: write to `INBOX.md`.

The run builds `docs/specs/2026-10-25-memory.md`, M1–M6 in its order, per Michael's brief of 2026-10-26 18:54 (`brief.md`): the retro backlog first; sessions never write `ledger/`; the seed file is never imported into the real ledger; evals are written to `evals/NEXT.md`, never run.

`feature_list.json`: 23 features in priority order; `passes` flips as each is verified by its session, `after` says what each waits on (M1, M2, M5 and M6 start independently; M3 and M4 wait on M2). A milestone whose features all pass is verified by an independent session and merged into `main`. Per milestone: M1 6 · M2 3 · M3 5 · M4 2 · M5 2 · M6 5.

Steer from the GitHub app: edit `INBOX.md` on this branch. First line `status: pause` or `status: stop [why]`; answers to questions go under `## Answers` (every session reads them; a parked feature is retried once answers change). Each entry's **Question for Michael** lines are what the sessions need from you; each took the simplest reversible default meanwhile.
